tasks.gr7-reading-aloud-t1: Topic: Reading aloud (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 1, oral skills). Cover preparing (read silently, mark pauses and hard words, practise), accuracy, fluency and expression, pace, volume, pause and tone, eye contact and posture, the criteria that a reading-aloud rubric usually looks at, and a timing sum (240 words at 120 words a minute is 2 minutes). Use general criteria only, no marks, no recordings and no poems. Ask simple Grade 7 questions.
tasks.gr7-listening-strategies-t2: Topic: Listening strategies (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 2, oral skills). Cover listening with a purpose, before, during and after listening, key words, note-taking with short forms, listening for names, numbers and order words, fact versus opinion and tone of voice, and a timing sum (300 words at 150 words a minute is 2 minutes). No recordings. Ask simple Grade 7 questions.
tasks.gr7-debate-skills-t3: Topic: Debate skills (Grade 7 English Home Language, Term 3, oral skills). Cover the motion, proposition and opposition, chairperson and timekeeper, point, reason and example, rebuttal, linking words, courtesy, cue cards, debate rubric criteria in general terms, and time sums (3 speakers of 2 minutes is 6 minutes a team; with a 1-minute rebuttal each, 14 minutes). No marks. Ask simple Grade 7 questions.
tasks.gr8-prepared-speech-t1: Topic: Prepared speech (Grade 8 English Home Language, Term 1, oral skills). Cover purpose and audience, opening, body and closing, rhetorical question, repetition, rule of three and call to action, cue cards, delivery (voice, eye contact, gestures), general rubric criteria and word-count arithmetic (3 minutes at 120 words a minute is 360 words; opening 45 and closing 45 leave 270 for the body). No marks. Ask simple Grade 8 questions.
tasks.gr8-listening-detail-viewpoint-t2: Topic: Listening for detail and viewpoint (Grade 8 English Home Language, Term 2, oral skills). Cover who, what, where, when, why and how many, listening for linking words, note-taking, main idea and supporting details, summarising a spoken text in your own words, viewpoint, bias, emotive words and tone, and a timing sum (360 words at 120 words a minute is 3 minutes). No recordings. Ask simple Grade 8 questions.
tasks.gr8-interview-skills-t3: Topic: Interview skills (Grade 8 English Home Language, Term 3, oral skills). Cover interviewer and interviewee, planning questions, open and closed questions, follow-up questions, courtesy and register, listening and notes, opening and closing, and a time sum (10 questions of 1 minute plus 2 minutes of introduction is 12 minutes). The written interview is a separate lesson. No marks. Ask simple Grade 8 questions.
tasks.gr9-prepared-speech-techniques-t1: Topic: Prepared speech and presentation techniques (Grade 9 English Home Language, Term 1, oral skills). Cover persuasive speech planning, hook, strong points with proof, call to action, rhetorical devices (rhetorical question, repetition, rule of three, contrast), appeals to reason, emotion and credibility, delivery, general rubric criteria and word-count arithmetic (4 minutes at 130 words a minute is 520 words; with 5 cue cards about 104 words a card). No marks. Ask Grade 9 questions.
tasks.gr9-meeting-oral-tasks-t2: Topic: Meeting oral tasks (Grade 9 English Home Language, Term 2, oral skills). Cover the agenda, chairperson, secretary, members and timekeeper, proposing and seconding, points of order, voting (12 for, 7 against and 3 abstain: 19 votes cast, 22 present, carried), formal language, minutes in the past tense, and time (6 items of 5 minutes is 30 minutes). Written minutes are a separate lesson. No marks. Ask Grade 9 questions.
tasks.gr9-debate-panel-discussion-t3: Topic: Debate and panel discussion (Grade 9 English Home Language, Term 3, oral skills). Cover debate versus panel, the role of the chairperson, evidence (facts, figures, examples, experts), rebuttal, fallacies such as attacking the person, answering audience questions honestly, courtesy, general rubric criteria and panel time (4 speakers of 3 minutes plus 2 minutes of chair plus 10 minutes of questions is 24 minutes). No marks. Ask Grade 9 questions.
